summary: Iter 23 KJAPP multi-mode architecture split verified end-to-end. Backend RBAC (10/10 pytest) confirms /api/admin/overview and /api/fleet/overview enforce 401 unauthenticated and 403 for wrong roles regardless of mode — customer/driver JWTs cannot access admin, customer/driver JWTs cannot access fleet, admin JWT reaches admin, fleet_owner JWT reaches fleet. Frontend Playwright (16/16) confirms: (1) mode detection via ?mode= override sets window.__KJAPP_MODE and correct Norwegian header text; (2) demo login buttons filtered per mode (fleet-only in fleet, admin-only in admin, all 4 in main); (3) correct-role logins route to /fleet, /loyver (superadmin lands on /loyver), /app (customer), /driver (driver); (4) WRONG-ROLE LOOP FIX WORKS — customer login on ?mode=fleet renders data-testid='wrong-portal' with 'flåteportalen' text and functional wrong-portal-logout button; same for admin mode with 'administrasjonsportalen'; NO redirect loops observed; (5) route isolation — visiting /app or /admin in fleet mode (unauth) and /fleet or /app in admin mode (unauth) redirects to /login and does not render customer/admin UI. Single REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL confirmed shared across all modes.
critical_code_review_comments: detectAppMode() persists ?mode= to localStorage['kjapp_mode_override'] — this is intentional for preview testing but note that switching modes on same host requires clearing localStorage or re-appending ?mode= (test harness handled this correctly).
Protected() sends wrong-role users in standalone portals to /login where PublicOnly() detects the authenticated wrong-role session and renders WrongPortal — this is the correct loop-breaking pattern.
test_admin_overview_unauthenticated_401 verified server returns 401 (not 403) for missing token, matching spec.
test_credentials: All 4 seeded accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md worked as documented.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded demo accounts.
